_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'We discover, develop, manufacture, and sell products in one significant business segment – pharmaceutical products.' (FY2007 10-K, Item 1); 'Our long-term success depends on intellectual property protection.' (FY2007 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'We currently expect no major U.S. patent expirations in the next three years, but several major products will lose intellectual property protection beginning in 2011.' (FY2007 10-K, Item 1A); 'Our product sales can be adversely affected by the introduction by competitors of branded products that are perceived as superior by the marketplace, by generic versions of our branded products, and by generic versions of other products in the same therapeutic class as our branded products.' (FY2007 10-K, Item 1A); 'Zyprexa sales of $4.76 billion represented 26 percent of our revenues in 2007.' (FY2007 10-K, Item 1A)

BEAR.desc: EPS -30.0%/yr (worst year FY98-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +18.3%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.3%/yr (FY98-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +22.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LLY (retrospective, 2008-04-11) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.11x (24.9% downside to Bear $39 / +235.1% upside to Bull $174) | Adj composite 3.15 vs market 1.00: gap +2.15 [UNDERVALUED] | -38% above the EPP floor $84 (22x FY08E $3.81) | Conservative 2-yr case: +195.7% total (+97.8%/yr) | At 13.6x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $69 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues n/r in Q4 2007, forward revenues +18% (no FY08 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2007 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
